business_summary: Fujian Supertch Advanced Material CO.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of vacuum insulation materials in China and internationally. It offers stainless steel building vacuum insulation panels, lightweight aluminum base vacuum insulation panels for buildings, class A energy-efficient vacuum insulation panels, metal vacuum insulation panels for ovens, lightweight vacuum insulation and vacuum armour panels, ultrathin vacuum insulation boards, vacuum insulation panel (VIPs) based on fumed silica, high temperature core material-based VIP products, rectangular and special-shaped vacuum insulation panel based on fiberglass, non-evapotranspiration adsorbent VIPs, and shell type four-sided sealing VIPs. The company also provides fiber glass wool VIP core materials; and FPC covering, skin-feel, regular aluminized polyester, metalized mylar, reinforced aluminized polyester, plated silicon oxide, aluminum-plastic laminated, aluminum-free laminated, nano barrier, fumed silica, battery barrier, floor heating, and flame-retardant films. In addition, it offers acoustic and thermal insulation materials; cold chain packaging products; vacuum insulating glass products; desiccant packs; and appliance glass series and getter products. Further, the company provides various types of insulation materials with customized solutions. Its products are used in household appliances, pharmaceutical cold chain, food delivery, building insulation, home insulation, and metal VIP industries. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Longyan, China.
